querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      s_tech_price1m,
                                      s_tech_price3m,
                                      s_tech_price1y,
                                      s_tech_rvi,
                                      s_tech_moneyflow20,
                                      s_tech_emv14,
                                      s_tech_emv6,
                                      s_tech_aroon,
                                      s_tech_aroondown,
                                      s_tech_aroonup,
                                      s_tech_ad6,
                                      s_tech_ad20,
                                      s_tech_ar,
                                      s_tech_br,
                                      s_tech_arbr,
                                      s_tech_cr20,
                                      s_tech_bearpower,
                                      s_tech_bullpower,
                                      s_tech_dhilo,
                                      s_tech_skewness,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_marketderivativefactor.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.marketderivativefactor WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
